tiers.description: Charity care will typically result in a sliding-scale co-payment due from the family; eligibility requires Federal Poverty Level below 250%.

evidence.quote: Federal Poverty Level below 250%; accounting for household size, income, and liquid assets

asset_test.details: Charity care decision is based on review of income, assets and liabilities; general requirements account for liquid assets.

evidence.quote: The decision to provide charity care will, in most cases, be based on a review of the family’s income, assets and liabilities at the time of visit, and will typically result in a sliding-scale co-payment due from the family.
The Financial Assistance Program is available to all patients who do not have health insurance and live in the United States.
Submission of required information within 365 days from the date that the first post-discharge billing statement for the care is provided

how_to_apply: Call Financial Counseling at 720-777-7001 (Anschutz Medical Campus, 13123 East 16th Avenue, Aurora, CO 80045) or 719-305-9993 (Colorado Springs, 4090 Briargate Parkway, Colorado Springs, CO 80920); application available at childrenscolorado.org.
warnings: No 100% free-care threshold stated; only a sliding-scale co-payment is described.
Policy effective date not stated; document code mentions 2019-05.
Policy says program is for patients without health insurance, and ineligibility for other health insurance is required.
Discount tier values are not specified beyond sliding scale; AGB limit applies to eligible individuals.
